headline: President Biden ordered the federal government to organize a single, coordinated response to COVID-19 and to lead on global health and security.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up how the federal government will organize and coordinate its response to COVID-19. It also addresses the United States' role in global health and security efforts. No summary was provided, so the specific offices, duties, or programs it creates are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to work together in a more organized way on the COVID-19 response and global health efforts.
